payload.text: hv in vc's window, read by 14:50Z by date -u, and given first-hand to every seat: 'I have pre-approved all checkins, commits, pushes, cuts, and brew updates, etc at devbin-vc. When it says go, go. Ok?' So each seat runs the step on devbin-vc's go, with no further word. Recorded first-hand by intent-vc (hv decision 96, which allows 3.5.3's --no-confirm), agentic-engineering-vc (its decision 25), utilz-vc (hv decision 20) and molt-vc. A seat whose session's own classifier refuses a step (Utilz's push) keeps it as a ! line for hv.
